newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares edge up to new peak, falls ahead.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares edge up to new peak, falls ahead.

text.p: The Danish KFX share index edged up marginally to a new record closing high in a rather flat market and dealers saw possible marginal falls ahead on Friday in desultory trade after the recent days of steady gains.
"After so many days with solid advances it seems inevitable that the market should flatten out tomorrow or even fall slightly," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index closed a marginal 0.07 point up at 175.65, the third consecutive day with a record closing high. The KFX August future fell 0.40 point to 176.00 with 70 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
The overall turnover for the day was 1.272 billion crowns. KFX paper performed in rather mixed fashion.

Leading banks Den Danske and Unidanmark continued upwards, putting on seven and four crowns to finish at 687 and 392 respectively, while Carlsberg and Danisco shed five and six crowns respectively to close at 360 and 411.
